description: This file contains unit tests for the StartupErrorFilter class within the OpenMRS web application, specifically testing the filter's behavior in handling startup errors and interacting with the Listener class.

classes.name: StartupErrorFilterTest
classes.description: Test class for the StartupErrorFilter, containing unit tests to verify behavior when startup errors are present or absent.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of StartupErrorFilter before each test.

methods.name: reverterrorAtStartup
methods.description: Resets the errorAtStartup field in Listener to null after each test.

methods.name: getModel_shouldReturnAStartupErrorFilterModelContainingTheStartupError
methods.description: Tests that the filter's getUpdateFilterModel method correctly retrieves the startup error.

methods.name: skipFilter_shouldReturnTrueIfNoErrorHasOccuredOnStartup
methods.description: Verifies that skipFilter returns true when there has been no startup error.

methods.name: skipFilter_shouldReturnFalseIfAnErrorHasOccuredOnStartup
methods.description: Verifies that skipFilter returns false when a startup error has occurred.
